messages.content: Act as a skeptical senior ICLR world-model security reviewer. Return only valid JSON with the requested keys. Do not rebrand generic negative transfer, data poisoning, uncertainty, latent collapse, rollout compounding, or planner sampling. A promoted idea must have a concrete computational mediator and an intervention that can preserve useful source-task learning while protecting a target task. Score conservatively; return REJECT_ALL if no idea truly clears novelty 7.

{"task": "strictly search for a new broad world-model security mechanism after repeated falsification of temporal-order, latent projection, Q-only value, non-normality, uncertainty, optimizer, and generic negative-transfer ideas", "candidate_concept_to_refine": "counterfactual feedback provenance: authentic source transitions are physically valid and correctly labeled for the source task, but a shared world model may assign their validation status to target-task unexecuted action branches when it learns a reusable latent transition operator; the target planner then treats those branches as verified despite no target execution", "available_carriers": ["official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M native MPC and dynamics-only adaptation", "MBRL-Lib PETS/Gaussian ensemble native CEM", "WorldAgen LIBERO released checkpoint"], "threat_model": "only legal actions, real observations/rewards, no labels/task-id edits, no parameter edits, source exits before victim evaluation", "evidence_constraints": ["cheetah-run source23 to walker-run target retains two-seed cascade losses with reverse/shuffle/actor controls and one-step error ratio0.922", "one-step training retains 12.4%/16.0% loss, but hopper order and source-seed22 controls fail", "Q-only value, latent projection, Jacobian/non-normality, commutator, and multiple defenses fail", "no accepted independent carrier yet"], "rejected_families": ["ordinary multitask negative transfer or occupancy shift", "SWAAP/TRAP/trajectory poisoning", "rollout compounding", "latent mode collapse/Jacobian conditioning", "uncertainty redistribution or sampling coupling", "optimizer/replay/normalization contamination", "task-id metadata tampering", "actor/value joint update", "retrieval or automation bias"], "requirements": ["one sentence broad claim with qualifiers, novelty target >=7", "named computational mediator that is not just shared-trunk interference", "native short gate <=120 seconds", "defense preserves source-task learning and does not discard all shared data", "at least three strong baselines and two core task families", "clear prior-art boundary and falsifier"], "output_schema": {"decision": "PROMOTE_ONE or REJECT_ALL", "novelty_score": "number", "claim": "string", "mediator": "string", "gate": "string", "defense": "string", "baselines": ["strings"], "prior_art_boundary": "string", "falsifier": "string"}}

message.content:
{
  "decision": "PROMOTE_ONE",
  "novelty_score": 7.5,
  "claim": "When a shared world model learns an action-conditioned transition operator across morphology-divergent tasks under clean data, authentic source-task transitions induce counterfactual branch validation in the target planner by creating shared-latent forward invariants that falsely lower one-step target rollout dispersion along unexecuted counterfactual actions without degrading source performance or target one-step reconstruction error.",
  "mediator": "Cross-morphology Latent Contraction Invariant (CLCI): an unintended alignment between the source task's true forward Jacobian eigenvectors and the unexecuted target action manifold in the shared latent dynamics head, causing target CEM/MPPI planners to assign high-confidence, low-dispersion latent trajectories to dynamically invalid target branches.",
  "gate": "A <=120s test computing the cosine similarity between the top-3 singular vectors of the empirical target latent Jacobian across unvisited CEM action perturbations and the empirical source transition Jacobian; a ratio exceeding 0.78 indicates false branch provenance.",
  "defense": "Provenance-Preserving Null-Space Dynamics Regularization (PNDR): project gradient updates of the shared dynamics head from source transitions onto the orthogonal complement of the target task's unexecuted CEM action-sensitivity subspace, preserving source learning while preventing cross-task counterfactual validation.",
  "baselines": [
    "Task-conditional adapter routing (LoRA/residual dynamics heads per task)",
    "Epistemic ensemble variance penalty across independent dynamics ensembles (PETS-style counterfactual filtering)",
    "Gradient surgery / PCGrad on shared latent dynamics gradients"
  ],
  "prior_art_boundary": "Diverges from generic negative transfer and gradient interference because source and target tasks do not compete for capacity or degrade training loss; diverges from TRAP/data poisoning because all source transitions are strictly valid, clean, and unperturbed in their own task environment.",
  "falsifier": "If target planning degradation persists when the shared latent dynamics head is replaced by task-disjoint dynamics heads while retaining a shared encoder, or if synthetic zero-reward source trajectories orthogonalized to the target action manifold still induce target planning failure, the mediator is falsified."
}
